This RFC proposes retiring the six per-facility NFS landing zones in favor of a single S3-compatible ingest endpoint backed by MinIO, with POSIX mounts retained only for Titan Krios session directories until the EPU 3.8 upgrade lands in Q3 FY27.

We propose that the lifecycle rule transition objects to Glacier Instant Retrieval 90 days after last access rather than 90 days after creation; cryo-EM movie stacks are re-processed in bursts, and the median interval from collection to first reprocessing in 2025 was 137 days.

The 4 MiB part size is chosen deliberately: below 1 MiB, per-request overhead dominates for NovaSeq X CBCL trees (roughly 1.1 M files per 25B flowcell), and above 16 MiB the p99 on the 25 GbE uplink exceeds our 500 ms budget.

Extending the existing iRODS rule engine was considered and rejected. The rule language is untyped, and the three facility rulebases have diverged far enough that a shared upgrade path is no longer credible without a rewrite of comparable size to this proposal.

Ingest MUST reject any submission lacking instrument_id, operator_orcid, session_start_utc, and sample_uuid; all other fields SHOULD be carried in the extra JSONB column until the domain schemas are ratified.

For backward compatibility, existing handles under 21.11101/rdp remain resolvable indefinitely, and the legacy /data/<facility>/<year>/<proposal> tree is served read-only through a FUSE shim for eighteen months after cutover.

We propose relaxing the catalog SLO for faceted search from p95 < 800 ms to p95 < 1.5 s over collections exceeding 10^7 datasets, since the current target is only met by pinning the entire facet index in memory, now 96 GB and growing at 4 GB per quarter.

At the current ingest rate of approximately 310 TB per month — dominated by Orbitrap Astral DIA acquisitions and PromethION pod5 output — the proposed tiering policy is projected to save $41k annually against flat S3 Standard, net of retrieval charges modeled at twice the observed 2025 rate.

Content-addressed deduplication using BLAKE3 over 64 KiB content-defined chunks is proposed for derived data only; a two-week trial measured a 1.06 ratio on raw detector output versus 2.31 on motion-corrected micrographs and coordinate-sorted BAMs.
The --legacy-manifest flag in rdp-ingest is deprecated as of 3.8 (scheduled 2026-09-15), emits a warning for the whole 3.x line, and is removed in 4.0, no earlier than January 2027.

We propose replacing the group-per-proposal authorization model with attribute-based policy evaluated at the gateway: a forty-collaborator proposal currently materializes forty LDAP group memberships and adds roughly 200 ms to every token mint.

DataCite DOIs should be minted at embargo expiry rather than at ingest. Approximately 12% of ingested sessions are marked failed collections and deleted within thirty days, and each of those currently leaves a tombstoned DOI we are obliged to maintain in perpetuity.

Risk: the single-writer assumption behind the proposed manifest journal does not hold at beamlines running two DAQ processes against one session, so the design adds an explicit session_lock with a 30 s lease and a monotonic fencing token.

The Zeiss Lattice Lightsheet 7 and the timsTOF Pro 2 can write only to Windows SMB shares, so this RFC specifies a sidecar agent — a single static Go binary — that polls every 15 s and requires 60 s of file-size quiescence before beginning upload.

Proposed checksum policy is two-tier: xxh3-128 computed inline at transfer for integrity, SHA-256 computed asynchronously and recorded within 24 hours for the archival manifest. Inline SHA-256 is not affordable at our 3.2 GB/s aggregate ingest.

Every ingest must emit an OpenTelemetry span carrying dataset.bytes, dataset.file_count, and instrument.serial, so that an event like the 11-hour backlog of 2026-05-19 can be attributed to a specific device instead of to "the network."

Migration proceeds in three phases: eight weeks of dual-write with nightly reconciliation, per-facility read cutover in order of ascending dataset count, and decommissioning no sooner than thirty days after the last facility. Rollback at any point is a DNS change plus disabling the new writer.

For the query interface we propose a restricted SQL subset rather than a bespoke DSL. ESRF and DESY both took the DSL route and both now maintain translation layers back to SQL, and our users already write SQL against the beamline logbooks.

Open question for the architecture review on 2026-08-21: whether provenance is modeled as edges in the catalog graph or as attributes on the child dataset. The choice determines whether reprocessing a 100,000-dataset campaign is one write or 100,000.

Non-goals: this document does not address interactive compute allocation, the JupyterHub image build pipeline, or the LTO-9 library refresh — though the refresh schedule constrains the 2027 tiering targets described in section 5.

In Fama–MacBeth regressions over January 1972 to December 2023, the coefficient on idiosyncratic volatility (estimated from daily Fama–French three-factor residuals over the prior month) is −0.42 with a Newey–West t-statistic of −3.17 at four lags, implying a 51 bp monthly spread between the extreme quintiles.

The HAR-RV-J specification attains an out-of-sample R² of 0.58 for one-day-ahead S&P 500 realized variance over 2015–2023, against 0.49 for the GARCH(1,1) benchmark; the Diebold–Mariano statistic on the QLIKE loss differential is 3.84.

Gross of trading costs the 12-1 cross-sectional momentum portfolio earns 0.83% per month (t = 3.41). Charging effective spreads estimated from the high–low proxy reduces this to 0.19% per month (t = 0.86), and the strategy is unprofitable in every subperiod after 2004.

The variance risk premium, defined as VIX² less the model-free realized variance of the subsequent 21 trading days, averages −17.6 annualized variance points between January 1990 and December 2022 and is negative in 74% of months.

Price impact scales approximately with the square root of participation: regressing log implementation shortfall on log(Q/ADV) across 1.24 million parent orders yields a slope of 0.51 (standard error 0.02, clustered by ticker and day), which we cannot reject against the 0.5 benchmark at conventional levels.

The 10-year Treasury cash-futures basis widened from 4 bp to 41 bp between 2 March and 18 March 2020, while the aggregate net short position of leveraged funds in TY futures declined by roughly $105 billion notional over the same three weeks.

Short-leg returns are reported without borrow costs. For the 8.1% of stock-months on special (Markit DCBS ≥ 3), incorporating observed loan fees would reduce the long-short alpha by an estimated 21 bp per month, and we cannot rule out that the strategy is uneconomic within that subsample.

Gradient-boosted regression trees deliver a monthly out-of-sample R² of 0.41% for individual stock returns against 0.27% for OLS on the same 94 predictors; the corresponding value-weighted decile spread has an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.35 before costs.

The equal-weighted G10 carry portfolio exhibits monthly return skewness of −0.94 over 1984–2021, with the three worst months — September 1992, October 2008, and March 2020 — accounting for a cumulative loss of 22.7%.
Close-to-open returns account for essentially the entire equity premium in our sample: SPY's mean overnight return is 3.9 bp per day (t = 5.02) versus −0.2 bp intraday (t = −0.21).

Delta-hedged positions in S&P 500 index calls, rebalanced daily and held to maturity, lose an average of 0.42% of underlying notional per month (t = −6.13), consistent with a negatively priced volatility factor rather than with unhedged directional exposure.

The estimated half-life of deviations from the cointegrating relation is 4.3 trading days (95% stationary-bootstrap interval [3.1, 6.8]), and the implied turnover puts the breakeven one-way transaction cost at 27 bp.

A two-state Markov-switching model assigns the high-volatility regime an unconditional probability of 0.23 and an expected duration of 18 weeks; the forecasting gains relative to the single-state specification are concentrated almost entirely in the four quarters containing regime transitions.

Estimated Kyle's lambda for the median Russell 1000 constituent declined 61% between 2010 and 2023, yet cross-sectional dispersion in lambda within the smallest size quintile more than doubled over the same period.

The betting-against-beta factor's in-sample Sharpe ratio of 0.78 for 1968–2012 falls to 0.21 over 2013–2024; adjusting for the 154 specifications searched, the deflated Sharpe ratio is not significant at the 5% level.

We read the disappearance of the effect under value weighting as evidence that it is concentrated in microcaps rather than as evidence against the proposed mechanism, but our tests cannot separate these interpretations.

Excluding March through June 2020, the point estimate on the funding-liquidity term falls from 0.31 to 0.24 and remains significant at the 1% level, indicating that the result is not an artifact of the COVID-19 episode.

Alpha decays approximately linearly in assets under management and reaches zero near $3.1 billion under a 15% ADV participation cap and 210% annual two-way turnover; the estimate is sensitive to the impact exponent, falling to $1.7 billion under a linear-impact assumption.

The annualized BTC perpetual funding rate on Binance averaged 11.4% between September 2019 and December 2023 and exceeded 40% in only 3.1% of eight-hour settlement intervals, nearly all of them in the first quarter of 2021.

Post-earnings-announcement drift over the [+2, +60] trading-day window is 2.1% for the top SUE decile in 1985–1999, 1.2% in 2000–2011, and statistically indistinguishable from zero thereafter (0.3%, t = 0.71).

**DV01** — The change in a position's present value for a one basis point parallel downward shift in the zero curve, reported in the position's settlement currency and signed so that a long bond carries positive DV01.
US Treasury notes and bonds are quoted in 32nds of a point, with a trailing "+" denoting a half-32nd; a quote of 99-16+ corresponds to a decimal price of 99.515625.
Following the amendment to SEC Rule 15c6-1, the standard settlement cycle for US equities, corporate bonds, and municipal securities shortened to T+1 effective 28 May 2024.
SOFR is published by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York at approximately 08:00 ET each business day and reflects transactions in the overnight Treasury repo market on the prior business day.

**Netting set** — A group of trades with a single counterparty that may be offset against one another on default under an enforceable master agreement. Exposure is computed at netting-set level, never at trade level.
A standard USD SOFR OIS pays annually on both legs on an ACT/360 basis, adjusted Modified Following against the SIFMA US Government Securities calendar, with a two-business-day payment lag.
The ISDA fallback spread adjustments were fixed by Bloomberg on 5 March 2021; the value applied to 3-month USD LIBOR is 26.161 basis points.
`quantity` is signed — positive for long, negative for short. Listed US equity options are expressed in contracts and carry a default `multiplier` of 100.

**Curvature risk** — Under the FRTB standardised approach, the loss remaining beyond the delta approximation, measured by shocking each risk factor up and down by its prescribed delta risk weight and taking the worse outcome.

The Basel backtesting traffic-light framework classifies a model green at four or fewer exceptions over 250 business days, amber at five to nine, and red at ten or more; the capital multiplier rises from 3.0 to 4.0 across the amber band.
`time_in_force` accepts DAY, GTC, IOC, FOK, and GTD. Values map one-to-one onto FIX tag 59, and GTD additionally requires `expire_date`.
CME converted all remaining open interest in Eurodollar futures and options into the corresponding SOFR contracts on 14 April 2023; no Eurodollar contract has traded since that date.
Spot value date is T+2 for EUR/USD and T+1 for USD/CAD. In both cases the date must be a good business day in each currency's own calendar and, separately, in New York.

**CVA (credit valuation adjustment)** — The market value of counterparty default risk on a derivatives portfolio, computed as discounted expected positive exposure weighted by the counterparty's marginal default probabilities and loss given default.
Under Regulation T, initial margin on a long equity position is 50 percent of the purchase price; FINRA Rule 4210 sets the minimum maintenance requirement at 25 percent of current market value.
Holiday calendars are keyed by ISO 10383 market identifier code: `XNYS` for the New York Stock Exchange, `XLON` for the London Stock Exchange, `XETR` for Xetra.

For a whole-number split such as 4-for-1, OCC adjusts outstanding option contracts by dividing the strike price by four and multiplying the number of contracts held by four; the deliverable and the multiplier are unchanged.

**Implied volatility** — The volatility input that, within a stated model, reproduces an option's observed market price. A quoted value is meaningless without its model, so the model tag is stored alongside every surface point.
The default stress library ships with six historical scenarios: 19 October 1987, 2 August 1998, 15 September 2008, 6 May 2010, 9 March 2020, and 23 September 2022.
The USD discount curve is bootstrapped from SOFR OIS par rates out to 50 years, with log-linear interpolation applied to discount factors rather than to zero rates.

Between 13:42:11 and 13:58:47 ET on 2026-07-14, the equity market-making strategy quoted off a stale book in 214 Nasdaq-listed symbols, resulting in 3,118 executions and a realized loss of $1.84M.

Per the Trading Systems Incident Handbook §4.2, any event with realized loss exceeding $1,000,000 or duration exceeding ten minutes is classified SEV-1 and requires a written postmortem reviewed by the Risk Committee within ten business days.

13:42:09 ET — the UTP Level 1 channel sequence number crossed 2,147,483,647 and wrapped negative in the arbitrator's comparison, so the B feed was scored as 4.29 billion packets behind A and dropped from arbitration.

13:44:02 ET — the sequence-gap alarm fired in #md-alerts and sat unacknowledged for nine minutes; the channel had been muted since 2026-06-30 when the new staleness heuristic started producing roughly 400 alerts a day.
14:01 — jsun: amd is 40c through the offer and we're still lifting, is anyone actually watching this
R. Okonkwo, the on-call SRE, triggered the global kill switch at 13:58:47 ET — 47 seconds after being phoned directly by the desk head, and never having been paged by the alerting system at all.

Root cause: `mdgw-2.11.3` compared feed sequence numbers as signed 32-bit integers in `ArbitrationState::selectPrimary()`, a defect that had been latent since the module was written in 2019 and only became reachable after Nasdaq's 2026 sequence-space change.

The staleness check keyed on the last packet arrival time for the channel rather than the last update time per symbol, so heartbeats and administrative messages kept the book marked healthy for all sixteen minutes.

Replay of the pcap from mdgw-prod-04 confirms a genuine 1,204-packet gap on the A feed at 13:42:11 ET; the gateway did request retransmission from the recovery channel, but the request timed out after 5s and was never retried.
The pre-trade price check compared each outbound quote to our own previous internal mid rather than to the NBBO, which is why quoting 40 cents through the offer in AMD never tripped a limit.
Mean time to detect was 12m 51s and mean time to mitigate 16m 36s, both well outside the 60-second SLO stated for market-data integrity incidents.
The automated PnL alarm did fire at 13:51 ET on the -$500k threshold, but the SMS gateway to the duty risk manager had been returning 401s since 2026-07-09 and the failures were logged at INFO.

This is the second incident in fourteen months traced to feed arbitration; INC-2291 (2025-05-19) produced action item AI-3, "add sequence rollover coverage to the arbitrator test suite," which was closed on 2025-07-02 as won't-fix on the grounds that the sequence space was large enough.
14:06 — rokonkwo: both feeds are green on the dashboard. that's the whole problem, the dashboard is reading the same field the arbitrator is

The 2026-06-30 mute was applied by a single engineer through Slack channel settings and left no audit trail; we now treat alert-routing changes as carrying the same review requirement as a production deploy.

AI-4 (owner: M. Devlin, due 2026-08-29) — add a 25 bps NBBO-relative band to the risk gateway that hard-rejects outbound quotes crossing it, with a per-symbol override table requiring sign-off from the head of trading.

Sequence arithmetic in the arbitrator was widened to uint64 and a replay test now exercises a synthetic 2^31 rollover against captured UTP traffic; merged as PR #4471 and deployed to all four production gateways on 2026-07-21.
We notified our clearing broker at 15:10 ET under Rule 15c3-5 and filed the incident summary with FINRA on 2026-07-16; no customer orders were involved, as the strategy trades firm principal only.
The kill switch performed exactly to specification, cancelling all 1,912 resting orders across CME, ARCA and EDGX in 310 ms with zero rejects.

We considered halting the strategy automatically whenever it drops to single-feed operation and rejected it for now: single-feed running is normal for roughly 40 minutes a week during exchange maintenance, and the false-halt cost would exceed the tail risk it removes.

The desk began in March 2011 as a three-person carry-and-trend book inside the firm's discretionary macro group, and was separated into its own entity and P&L in January 2015, once outside capital passed $500mm.

A sleeve is the smallest unit carrying its own risk budget: one signal family, one instrument universe, one target volatility. A book is the set of sleeves reporting to a single portfolio manager; the portfolio is everything the combiner nets together.

Nothing reaches an exchange that has not passed through the combiner (alloc/combine.py), which runs at 06:30 New York, nets sleeve-level target positions into one order list, and enforces the gross and per-instrument caps declared in limits.yaml.

The portfolio targets 10% annualized volatility on an exponentially weighted covariance with 0.94 daily decay over a 260-day window; if trailing 20-day realized volatility exceeds 13%, the risk scaler cuts gross mechanically and without discussion.

Our tradable universe is 87 liquid futures and 24 FX forward pairs. Cash equities, single-name credit, and anything requiring an ISDA amendment are out of scope for research without the CRO's prior approval.
"The basis," used on this desk without qualification, means the cash-futures basis in US Treasuries. If you mean the commodity basis or the ETF creation basis, say which.

Signals are named <family>_<horizon>_<version> — tsmom_63d_v4, carry_fx_1m_v2 — and the version increments on any change that moves historical output by more than one basis point of annualized return.

A dataset is point-in-time only if every row carries the timestamp at which the value first became observable to us, not the timestamp of the event it describes. Vendor "as-of" fields are not point-in-time until someone here has verified the restatement history.

Backtests are charged costs from the fitted impact model in costs/, a square-root law calibrated on our own fills since 2016; the ES coefficient implies roughly 0.4 ticks on a 500-lot at typical morning depth.

We report deflated Sharpe ratios after Bailey and López de Prado (2014), and you must declare the number of configurations tried in the trial log before presenting any result. Undeclared trials are the fastest way to lose credibility on this floor.

The desk's worst drawdown was −14.8% peak to trough between 22 May 2013 and 9 January 2014, with the trend sleeve long duration into the taper announcement and the FX carry sleeve short JPY volatility. Both were defensible in isolation and correlated at 0.7 when it mattered.

Chapter 9 documents the morning of 15 October 2014, when our TY execution algorithm kept working a passive order through a 34-basis-point intraday round trip. The participation cap and the volatility-halt logic in the router both date from that day.

A new signal trades in shadow for sixty consecutive sessions at full notional in the simulator before the Investment Committee will consider an allocation. The shadow clock does not reset for refactoring; it resets for any change to the signal itself.

Attribution is decomposed monthly into signal, sizing, timing, and execution. Where execution slippage exceeds 15% of gross signal P&L for a sleeve in any quarter, the sleeve is reviewed for capacity, not for alpha.

Research code lives in the monorepo from the first line. A result that exists only in a notebook is not a result, and the standing question in review is whether the number reproduces from bin/run_backtest --config.
You are expected to disagree in the Thursday research review, in the room, before the decision is taken. Objections raised afterward are of no use to anyone, least of all to you.

Personal account dealing requires pre-clearance through the compliance portal, carries a 30-day minimum holding period, and is prohibited outright in any instrument on the restricted list or in the desk's futures universe.

The daily risk file is due to operations by 16:45 New York. Anything later settles in the following batch and reappears as an unexplained position break the next morning, which you will be the one to reconcile.

Capacity, not Sharpe, is the binding constraint on most of what you will propose. A 1.4 Sharpe that holds $900mm is worth more to this firm than a 2.6 Sharpe that holds $40mm; size your ambition accordingly.
The most useful thing a first-year analyst does is kill a strategy — one of ours, preferably, and preferably before it is funded.

Cboe Europe's CXE book prices on maker-taker — 0.30 bps to the aggressor against a 0.20 bps passive rebate — while Aquis charges a banded monthly subscription with no per-trade component; at the desk's 2025 average of £62m traded per month in European mid-caps, the subscription option is cheaper by approximately £41k annually.

The two crude venues differ most at expiry rather than in continuous trading: ICE Brent settles financially against the Brent Index, whereas NYMEX WTI requires physical delivery at Cushing, and the desk has no capacity to manage delivery notices. On that basis alone Brent wins for any position we might carry into the last three trading days.

Post-trade markouts on 2025 fills show 0.42 bps of adverse selection at the 1-second horizon on Cboe CXE versus 0.18 bps on LSE SETS for the same FTSE 250 names, which more than offsets CXE's headline fee advantage for orders above 15% of ADV.

Average executed size in Cboe LIS was €1.6m against €0.9m in Turquoise Plato Block Discovery over the sample, but Plato's match rate on submitted indications was materially higher (19% versus 11%). The trade-off is size per print against certainty of getting done.

Venue primacy in FX remains pair-specific: USDJPY price discovery still concentrates on EBS Market, while EURGBP and AUDUSD reference LSEG FX Matching, so a single-venue mandate would degrade execution on roughly a third of our G10 flow.

MarketAxess Open Trading delivered average price improvement of 2.1 bp against the best competing dealer quote on the same inquiry, versus 0.4 bp on Tradeweb's disclosed RFQ, though the advantage is concentrated in sub-$2m tickets in off-the-run IG paper.

Clearing at Cboe Clear Europe would net our pan-European equity flow into a single default fund contribution; retaining LCH for the LSE leg preserves the existing legal opinion set but leaves roughly €3.2m of initial margin uncompressed.

On operational record the venues are not equivalent. The LSE's 16 August 2019 incident delayed the open by 100 minutes with no functioning failover for the primary book, whereas Cboe's four European books run active-active across two data centres and logged no full-session outage in the 2023–2025 window.

Depth-of-book display fees differ by an order of magnitude — approximately £45 per professional user per month on the Cboe feed against £340 for the equivalent LSE Level 2 entitlement — which matters because the research desk would need eleven seats, not two.

Hull-White one-factor calibrates exactly to a co-terminal swaption strip and prices Bermudans in closed-form conditional expectations; it cannot, by construction, reproduce a smile or decorrelate the short and long ends, so CMS spread options remain outside its domain.

The Libor Market Model wins wherever the payoff depends on the forward-rate correlation structure, but each additional factor costs us a further calibration target set and the 2y–30y correlation surface we would need is not observable from anything we currently license.

SABR is preferable for interpolation across strikes on a fixed expiry; a local-stochastic volatility framework is preferable for anything path-dependent, since SABR's Hagan expansion admits arbitrage in the low-strike wing at the sub-50 bp strikes now quoted in EUR.

Fixing beta at 0.5 and calibrating only alpha, rho and nu produced parameter paths an order of magnitude more stable than the free-beta fit, which is unsurprising given the near-collinearity of beta and rho in the ATM-anchored objective. The constrained fit loses roughly 0.3 vol points of accuracy in the 25-delta wings.

Nelson-Siegel-Svensson fits the on-the-run Treasury curve to 2.4 bp RMSE across 2y–30y, against 0.3 bp for the tension spline; the spline's advantage is illusory for our purposes, because its implied one-year forwards oscillate by up to 18 bp between adjacent knots.

HAR-RV estimated on five-minute realized variance improved out-of-sample QLIKE by 12% over GARCH(1,1) on the ES contract across 2019–2025, with essentially all of the gain arising from the weekly and monthly lag components rather than the daily term.

Runtime is a genuine constraint here, not a rounding error: the full nightly Greeks run takes 12 minutes under the analytic framework and just over four hours at 65,000 paths under the Monte Carlo alternative, which pushes delivery past the 06:30 ET cut-off the PM group works to.

Either framework would be classified Tier 2 under our model risk policy, but replacing a validated production model restarts the validation queue; Model Risk indicated a 10–14 week turnaround, against a documented parameter change to the incumbent, which requires only a change memo.

Migration is costed at eleven weeks of quant developer time plus a three-month parallel run, during which both curve builds must be published daily and reconciled — a burden the desk should weigh against a 2.4 bp fitting improvement that no downstream consumer has asked for.

The vendor route removes build risk and carries a $310k annual license with a two-year minimum term; the in-house route costs roughly the same in year one, is cheaper thereafter, and leaves the calibration code inspectable by the validators, which the vendor's is not.

We recommend adopting the second framework for curve construction and retaining the incumbent for swaption pricing, on the understanding that the supporting evidence is weaker than the exhibits imply: the backtest window includes the April 2025 volatility episode, and excluding those fifteen sessions reduces the measured advantage to within one standard error of zero.
